adjustment_values_match_target.name: adjustment_values_match_target
adjustment_values_match_target.value:
(
        ("adjustments"."target_table" = 'stock_movements' and "adjustments"."old_value" between 0 and 99999999999.999
          and "adjustments"."new_value" between 0 and 99999999999.999) or
        ("adjustments"."target_table" = 'attendance' and "adjustments"."old_value" in (0, 1, 2) and "adjustments"."new_value" in (0, 1, 2)) or
        ("adjustments"."target_table" = 'wage_payments'
          and "adjustments"."old_value" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and "adjustments"."new_value" between 1 and 9007199254740991
          and "adjustments"."old_value" = trunc("adjustments"."old_value") and "adjustments"."new_value" = trunc("adjustments"."new_value"))
      )

checklist_event_reason.name: checklist_event_reason
checklist_event_reason.value: "checklist_events"."kind" not in ('added', 'renamed', 'removed', 'sent_back') or ( "checklist_events"."note" is not null and length(btrim("checklist_events"."note")) >= 10 )

material_quantities_nonnegative.name: material_quantities_nonnegative
material_quantities_nonnegative.value:
"materials"."planned_qty" between 0 and 99999999999.999
    and "materials"."low_stock_qty" between 0 and 99999999999.999
    and "materials"."stock_qty" between 0 and 99999999999.999

proposal_decision_shape.name: proposal_decision_shape
proposal_decision_shape.value: ("proposals"."status" = 'pending' and "proposals"."decided_by" is null and "proposals"."decided_at" is null) or ("proposals"."status" <> 'pending' and "proposals"."decided_by" is not null and "proposals"."decided_at" is not null)

stock_movement_shape.name: stock_movement_shape
stock_movement_shape.value:
"stock_movements"."qty" between -99999999999.999 and 99999999999.999 and (
      ("stock_movements"."type" = 'delivery' and "stock_movements"."qty" > 0 and nullif(btrim("stock_movements"."supplier"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("stock_movements"."challan_no"), '') is not null and "stock_movements"."unit_cost_paise" is not null
        and "stock_movements"."unit_cost_paise" between 0 and 9007199254740991) or
      ("stock_movements"."type" in ('usage', 'adjustment') and "stock_movements"."qty" <> 0 and
        ("stock_movements"."type" <> 'usage' or "stock_movements"."qty" < 0)
        and "stock_movements"."supplier" is null and "stock_movements"."challan_no" is null and "stock_movements"."unit_cost_paise" is null)
    )

worker_removal_metadata.name: worker_removal_metadata
worker_removal_metadata.value:
("workers"."removed_reason" is null and "workers"."removed_at" is null)
          or (not "workers"."active" and "workers"."removed_reason" is not null and "workers"."removed_at" is not null
              and char_length(btrim("workers"."removed_reason")) between 5 and 2000)
